items.name: Total backlog and options, Q2 fiscal 2026
items.claim: KBR's backlog and options totaled $23.0 billion as of the quarter end, with a 1.1x book-to-bill for the quarter.
items.source_excerpt: Backlog and options as of the quarter end totaled $23.0 billion. Book-to-bill1 was 1.1x for the quarter.

items.name: Antarctic Science and Engineering Support Contract (ASESC)
items.claim: KBR was awarded the $8 billion ceiling Antarctic Science and Engineering Support Contract, a single-award IDIQ for the U.S. National Science Foundation covering Antarctic Program stations and research camps over a 20-year period of performance.
items.source_excerpt: Awarded the $8 billion ceiling Antarctic Science and Engineering Support Contract (ASESC) , a single-award IDIQ contract for the U.S. National Science Foundation, to support U.S. Antarctic Program stations and research camps over a 20-year period of performance.

items.name: U.S. Space Force digital engineering support contract
items.claim: KBR was awarded a $95 million cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide Digital Engineering and Enterprise Decision Support capabilities for the U.S. Space Force at Kirtland Air Force Base over a five-year period.
items.source_excerpt: Awarded a $95 million cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide Digital Engineering and Enterprise Decision Support capabilities for the U.S. Space Force at Kirtland Air Force Base over a five-year period of performance.

notes: Q2 fiscal 2026 results release carries a dense set of backlog and new-award disclosures; selected the total backlog figure plus the two largest new contract awards with explicit dollar figures.
